Stair Climber.kerala_gym_notes: Popular lower body sculpting and calorie-burning cardio machine. Stand upright without bearing weight on console handles.

Jump Rope.kerala_gym_notes: Almost universally called 'Skipping' in Kerala gyms and sports academies. Jump lightly on the balls of your feet.

Jumping Jacks.kerala_gym_notes: Universal calisthenics warmup and HIIT circuit drill. Land with soft knees to protect joints.

High Knees.kerala_gym_notes: Athletic sprinting drill used in HIIT and warmup circuits. Pump arms dynamically while driving knees upward.
